attributes.board_name: Board of Dental Examiners of Alabama

rules.accepted_credit_types: Training by national, state, district or local dental or dental hygiene associations and by accredited dental or dental hygiene schools; other courses may be pre-approved by the Board. 1 hour = 50 minutes of instruction; teaching earns 2 hours per hour taught
rules.new_licensee_rule: Applicants must show at least BLS and infectious disease control training.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: hours must be completed and submitted within the renewal period in which they were earned.
rules.audit_note: Random audits of documents uploaded to CE Broker; keep CE records for 2 years. Failed audit leads to administrative penalties (r. 270-X-5-.09).

topics.who: Prescribing of controlled substances, every year
Ethical considerations in the practice of dentistry
Current live BLS (AHA/Red Cross or equivalent)

rules.notes: At least 10 of 20 hours live (in person). Current BLS (2-4 h, live, AHA/Red Cross or equivalent) required. Max 4 h insurance/regulations/risk management, 3 h practice management, 4 h pro bono in Alabama. Sedation/anesthesia permit holders: ACLS or PALS yearly; oral conscious sedation permit: 2 h sedation CE yearly.
